profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience building ML-driven systems and full-stack applications across defense, cloud, and research environments. Strong background in Python, full-stack development, and cloud infrastructure with hands-on experience in agentic AI workflows, ML-enabled applications, and production-grade tooling.

positions.title: Space Federal Product Engineering Software Intern
positions.description: Developed a Python script using REST API endpoints and Postman API to automate demo configurations for Kratos' OpenSpace Platform. Utilized Docker, Kubernetes, and Rancher for efficient container management and orchestration. Leveraged AWS services to enhance deployment processes and support platform configuration.
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Postman API · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cloud Computing · Kubernetes · Docker · Rancher Kubernetes Management

positions.title: Machine Learning Research Fellow
positions.description:
In collaboration with the Hume Center for National Security at Virginia Tech.
Create Convolutional Neural Networks in PyTorch to perform multi-class classification for improved RF spectrum sensing. Use Cloud services from aws to load and train data used in neural networks more effectively. Analyze collaborative sensing among radios using cloud services in order to better coordinate and improve decision making for all radios.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
CS 3114 - Data Structures and Algorithms.
Conducted office hours for 8 hours a week to reinforce key concepts, troubleshoot challenging problems, and facilitate group discussions to promote collaborative learning. Utilized Java to demonstrate implementation of data structures and algorithms in practical examples
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Assistant Teaching · Undergraduate Teaching

company.name: Virginia Tech Department of Computer Science

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Analyzed the Ionosphere's effect on high frequency (HF) propagation through carrier recovery to provide research and knowledge of its behavior in non-polar locations.
Created a Python application to sort through 200,000+ .wav files and output Matplotlib plots of the carrier phase and magnitude to study and understand the variance between the synthetic and received waveforms.
Implemented back-end algorithms as well as a GUI to display the results from each intended .wav sample.
Utilized git to collaborate with fellow interns and incorporated different python packages and libraries into application such as Numpy, Scipy, Matplotlib, Maidenhead, and PyQt5.
positions.insights: Skills: Digital Signal Processing · Programming · Object Oriented Design · Signals · Data Science · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Conducted research to develop a simulation environment (RFRL Gym) with OpenAI Gym to address two cognitive radio applications, specifically dynamic spectrum access and jamming.
Trained and tested Q-learning/Epsilon Greedy algorithms using MushroomRL to build an RL agent.
Open-sourced this codebase to allow researchers to utilize RFRL Gym, providing a platform for third-party testing of RL algorithms and ultimately contributing to the advancement of RL research.
Presented findings to the Principal Deputy Director of National Intelligence at the VT Colloquium conference.
Collaborated amongst research assistants to publish a white paper in efforts to increase application usage and contribute to RL research.
positions.insights: Skills: Reinforcement Learning · Machine Learning · PyTorch · Programming · pyqt5 · Python (Programming Language)
